stages.description: Canonical source revision selected for the release run.
Deterministic validation completed for the scoped release candidate.
Deployable artifact/package was assembled from the scoped candidate.
The scoped release worker completed its production write/publish operation.
Fresh anonymous visitor/runtime verification completed after deployment.
The global production checkpoint advanced to the source revision after all planned lanes passed.

rules: A merged commit or green source build is not deployment evidence.
A deployed stage must not be marked verified unless the release worker reports success.
A liveVerified stage must not be marked verified unless post-deploy verification reports success.
A checkpointed stage must not be marked verified unless the dtfseeds-production tag advancement step succeeds for the same source SHA.
workflow-aggregate means the parent observed a successful child workflow that owns deeper evidence; it is not equivalent to exact stage-specific proof.
Later stages cannot be verified when an earlier required production stage failed.
